item.title: Week 10: Panthers at Saints
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: NO -1.5 · O/U 48.5 | Model NO 46% vs. market 50% | On paper this one is close: Carolina's best edge is to tackle in space (Carolina's defense ranks 1st in YAC over expected per catch, -0.6 yds allowed), while New Orleans's best counter is to keep the pocket clean (New Orleans ranks 7th in QB hit + sack rate, 14%). Under center, Bryce Young ranks 14th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Tyler Shough ranks 16th; x-factor: Chris Olave gets 29% of New Orleans' targets and 46% of its air yards, and Carolina's pass defense ranks 25th. The model favors Carolina at 54%, mostly on rushing matchup (2.0 pts) and offensive injuries (1.4 pts).
